title: Green Crosshair
description: Adds a Green crosshair to minecraft
body:
This resource pack replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with a clean blue version.

The goal is to improve visibility while keeping a simple, vanilla-friendly look. The blue color helps the crosshair stand out better in different environments, making it easier to aim and focus.

Features:

* Green crosshair
* Clean and minimal design
* Easy to see in most backgrounds

Works with vanilla Minecraft. No mods required.

---

Installation:

1. Open your `.minecraft` folder (type `%appdata%` in the Windows search bar).
2. Go to the `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Place the pack inside.
4. Enable it in the Resource Packs menu.

---

Simple, clean, and easy to use. You can check out some of my other resource packs using these links:
